decisions.rationale: duplicate_row_rate 0.08 over 5000 rows reads as capture artifacts; exact duplicates over (order_id, line_no, sku, order_ts) are excluded.
4000 distinct Order ID values over 5000 rows with LineNo 1 through 7 make (order_id, line_no) the smallest plausible line identity; measured before approval.
qty samples mix integers, decimals, and words; a cast needs a mapping review first.
ship_date samples carry several date shapes and placeholders; no single cast is safe.
customer_email (null_rate 0.97) and notes (null_rate 0.61) are retained as nullable, never imputed.
unit_price min is -5.0; negative prices are retained and flagged for review rather than silently dropped.
The three _airbyte_ columns are capture-tool metadata, never business columns.

purpose: The cleaned, typed, one-row-per-order-line view of the messy_orders landing table: the contracted silver table for a source whose identifiers, quantities, and dates arrived inconsistent.
usage: Read silver.silver_messy_orders for order-line analysis. qty, ship_date, and is_gift stay text until their mappings are reviewed; status values are not case-normalized here.
limitations: Exact duplicate rows (rate 0.08 at v0001) are excluded as capture artifacts; customer_email is 97 percent null and notes 61 percent null; negative unit prices are retained for review.
